skills.description: Design for dynamic windows: - phone; - tablet; - foldable; - desktop windowing; - connected displays.

skills.name: Perceived Performance
skills.description: Perceived latency is a design problem only after real performance is treated seriously.

skills.name: UI Performance
skills.description: Watch: - LCP — important content appears quickly; - CLS — layout remains stable; - INP — interactions respond quickly.

skills.name: Product & Surface Archetypes
skills.description: Needs: comprehension, evidence, trust, conversion. Good: refined, editorial SaaS, technical precision, controlled spatial. Avoid: fake metrics, generic gradient blobs, floating dashboard collage by reflex.

skills.name: React Native Reanimated 4
skills.description: Use for React Native app motion when the project is compatible with Reanimated 4 / New Architecture. Do not silently force a major architecture migration just to add animation.

skills.name: Research First
skills.description: Research is mandatory for substantial unfamiliar/brand-critical/creative work when tools permit; it is intentionally skipped for trivial edits.

skills.name: Responsive Layout & Proportion

skills.name: Scroll & Interactive Storytelling
skills.description: Scroll can be navigation, reading progression, animation input or scene time. Decide which.

skills.description: Millie is not a replacement for a security/backend skill. This reference prevents frontends from creating unsafe or dishonest UX around backend/security behavior.

skills.name: UX & Product Interaction
skills.description: Visual quality cannot rescue a poor task model.

skills.name: Verification & Audit
skills.description: Preferred: 1. complete implementation pass; 2. render representative environments in one batch; 3. collect all defects; 4. one consolidated fix; 5. one confirmation pass; 6. stop.

skills.name: Millie UI Workflow
skills.description: Local component/style/state fix. Inspect local evidence, apply the smallest coherent change, verify. Do not trigger full external research.
